editorial:
You are dropped into a tense race against time when three hidden nuclear bombs threaten America. A hardened interrogator and an FBI agent must work together, but their methods clash hard. The mood is dark, serious, and uncomfortable, with every minute feeling like it matters. You watch as trust breaks down, tempers flare, and hard choices pile up fast. You feel the pressure building with each scene. The story keeps pulling you into the room where everything is decided.

Samuel L. Jackson brings intense energy, while Carrie-Anne Moss adds grounded emotion. The pacing stays tight and the questions keep you guessing. It can feel heavy and morally messy, so it is not a light watch. If you like dark thrillers and tough choices, this is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture. The ending may leave you talking.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the interrogator pushes past every limit and kills the suspect after getting the bomb locations. The FBI agent is left shaken, and the team races to stop the attacks. The bombs are found in time, but the cost is huge. The twist is that the brutal methods work, but they leave everyone morally broken. You are left wondering if saving millions justifies crossing that line.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark thrillers and moral dilemmas.
